qa_pairs.question: What usage statistics are available for individual virtual machines in the cloud section?
qa_pairs.answer: Each virtual machine in the cloud section provides usage statistics for CPU Cores, Memory, Disk Bandwidth, Disk IOPS, and Network Bandwidth.

qa_pairs.question: For what periods can users view the usage statistics of virtual machines?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can view virtual machine usage statistics for the last month, last week, last day, or last hour.
